findings.title: Carry the shared admitted budget into dispatch's closed target set
findings.observation: Admission declares binding-local invocation_budget private read/write and remaining_shared_budget. Dispatch only reads revision_intent/claim_fence, declares no budget reference and only the aggregate frozen_provider_attempts_timeout_egress_outcomes obligation. Its exact target table therefore has no way to express that provider retries consume the same admitted invocation budget rather than a newly allocated independent one.
findings.contract_basis: SERVICE shared nested-adapter budget and TBP03 admitted-intent dispatch under frozen provider limits; exact private target sets are the purpose of this candidate slice. This does not require choosing 60s/40s or runtime implementation.
findings.reproduction: The independent healthy-source required-boundary probe expects the already-defined job.overdue_reminders.delivery.reminder_v1.invocation_budget in dispatch private_read_targets; it is absent, exit1. Source still matches after the getter-only drift.
findings.minimal_correction: Include the same binding-local InvocationBudget as dispatch private read (or an equally explicit typed same-budget admitted-context edge), and an individual unproved shared-budget consumption/no-reset obligation. Do not add ordinary policy effects, a new live-policy cut, a database transaction across HTTP, or numeric defaults. Counter/outcome persistence remains on the existing private intent/completion boundary unless separately specified.
findings.acceptance: Whole-table expectation includes the same qualified budget identity in admission and dispatch; renamed-job test moves both; graph/offset invariance holds. A required-boundary probe for same-budget consumption passes. Completion remains without new live role/visibility checks and all delivery export stays refused.

findings.title: Expose individual admission live requirements instead of one aggregate label
findings.observation: Authority facts correctly identify credential status/expires/revoked fields, Service status, selected membership/member and role. Admission only emits live_credential_service_membership_role, with no separately inspectable credential expiry or revocation requirements or selected membership/role-presence requirements. Source-field inventories are not the missing individual live predicates.
findings.contract_basis: DBSP03 explicitly distinguishes active/expiry/revocation obligations and TBP03 requires individual unproved live requirements. The static table is deliberately incomplete/nonexecuting, so these should be visible unproved facts, not implemented live authority.
findings.reproduction: Healthy-source required-boundary probe searches admission unproved requirements for expiry and revocation; both absent, exit1. Full row fixture expectation currently duplicates this omission.
findings.minimal_correction: Emit separate closed obligations tied to existing checked slots: credential active, not expired, not revoked; selected Service active/resolved identity; selected authoritative application membership present/current and selected role equality/authorization. Preserve immutable recipient authorization and explicit immutable payload comparison/retention requirement from TBP03 as unproved admission obligations, not values or broad grants. Retain aggregate compatibility label only if desired, not as replacement for individual facts.
findings.acceptance: Independently expected entire table names each condition and binds its source slot/selected authority; current expiration/revocation/member/role evidence remains false/unproved. Negatives keep their existing Error/refusal controls. Dispatch and completion must not receive new post-admission role, recipient or visibility checks.

passing_inspection: Exact selected validator graph identity authentication.api_bearer.validator.service_key.api_key, mode api_key/principal service, actual credential identity and distinct slot entity matching are checked.
Credential principal and membership member require explicit owning-reference target exactly Service actual identity plus nominal ancestry; unrelated Uuid/Service.owner_id does not pass.

Effective inherited nullability and required presence checked for credential/member/role/principal identity/active fields; service/credential/membership/Todo/User same explicit authority store checked.
Selected membership is checked against that entity's PolicyModel.memberships contract, not any role-type union. Active owner visibility is exact no-payload enum active equality.
Competing entity/service descriptors clear all phase candidates after phase errors; no partial completed binding is issued.

Four rows are closed fixed array, ordered phase names; set targets use canonical BTreeSets; job/binding-qualified private target names not NodeIds/offsets. Payload maps exact checked source identities, no values/secrets.

Selection has no general entity write/provider invoke. Admission has private enrollment/fence/budget state only. Dispatch only selected external operation. Completion only Todo.reminder_sent_at write, no lifecycle/role visibility predicates, original intent receipt/fence/revision/unsent obligations.

Construction is parent-private and fields private; read-only candidate getter exposes immutable slice, candidate_facts creates owned inspection JSON. Mutating returned JSON does not mutate model. No private checked graph nodes/extra ordinary call edges or changed ordinary run effect/field obligations.
